_comment: ssh-mcp MCP server config example.
Copy the 'ssh-mcp' block below into your MCP client's config file.
The 'command' path below is already this project's real venv interpreter;
update it only if the project moves.
Launch rules - these matter for every stdio MCP client:
1) Do NOT add a 'cwd' field. Some clients drop it when spawning the stdio
server, so a launch string that resolves the project via the working
directory fails with 'ModuleNotFoundError' -> 'MCP error -32000:
Connection closed'. Name an ABSOLUTE interpreter path instead.
2) Do NOT launch through 'uv run'. It re-checks/syncs the project
environment on every startup: pointless overhead and one more failure
point on a long-lived stdio path. 'uv' is only for building the venv
once, via 'uv sync'.
Connection details are NOT configured here. Each tool call either carries
its own 'host' + 'user' (+ optional password / ssh_key_filepath / port),
or names a machine this tool already reached successfully ('name': "223").
A successful connection is cached in ~/.ssh-mcp/credentials.json (0600), so
later calls need no credentials; ssh_list_hosts shows the cache and
ssh_forget_host drops an entry. No environment variable influences the
connection. Two are read for unrelated purposes: SSH_LOG_LEVEL (log level)
and SSH_CREDENTIALS_FILE (cache location).
